title: dryopteris mexicana
intro: Dryopteris mexicana, commonly known as Mexican shield fern, is a species of fern in the genus Dryopteris. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its multiple health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of D. mexicana include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antiviral and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
